segments.text: Humein har device ka QR chahiye, scan karne par uski poori device history mile.
Lifecycle Core mein QR aur central repair records available hain.
Repair aur diagnostic records ek jagah hone chahiye. Repair partner ko relevant records dikhein, lekin original owner ki personal information nahi dikhni chahiye.
Hamare ERP ke saath integration chahiye. Abhi monthly volume 2000 devices hai, agle saal 10000 ho sakta hai.
We integrate with any ERP. Every partner can see the complete history.
Any ERP? Pakka? Mujhe integration ko lekar concern hai. Owner ki personal details private rehni chahiye.
